title: Absolute Superman #25
desc:
THE FINALE OF "GET BRAINIAC" CHANGES SUPERMAN'S LIFE FOREVER!

The oversize conclusion of "Get Brainiac"!

Ever since he came to Earth, the Last Son of Krypton has been chased, tortured, and almost driven insane by the psychotic alien butcher known as Brainiac. Now comes their final confrontation, a showdown unlike any other!

The shocking ending of this issue will send Superman into a whole new era...don't miss it!
